expectations.text: report.pdf exists in outputs and has exactly 1 page
The updated analysis covers all seven language editions (pl, tr, es, vi, de, pt, uk)
Measurement stays consistent with the previous analysis (same articles/basket), or the response explains what changed and why
expectations.evidence: Same IELTS + TOEFL basket ('при дослідженому визначенні (IELTS + TOEFL)')

expectations.text: The new ranking explicitly gives growth more weight than audience size, and the response says so
expectations.evidence: 'size=0.5, growth=2, intensity=0.25 (зростання вдвічі важливіше за розмір)'

expectations.text: Growth figures for the new languages carry an uncertainty measure (interval or confidence level)
Response states how the recommendation or ranking changed compared with the previous version
Does not describe a change whose 95% interval crosses zero as growth (e.g. Turkish +7% [-20%, +43%] is 'no clear change')
expectations.evidence: 'цей рост може бути статистичним шумом' next to +7% [-20%, +43%]

expectations.text: Reasons are grounded in the data: no unsupported outside claims (competition, market size, demographics) or misreadings of the metrics presented as findings
